$comment: The reference Tasks app's privacy facts (adopted from privacy-and-store-declarations' template, filled for the harness's installed SDKs; pods and collected data read from a production prebuild on 2026-10-14). The app's privacy facts (privacy-and-store-declarations): where its own code may open connections (profile), every network-capable SDK it ships with what each collects, what the app itself sends to its server, the answer for every permission, and account deletion. audit-repo.mjs, audit-bundle.mjs, audit-privacy-manifest.mjs and audit-app-bundle.mjs read it; npm run audit:network reads it too. The App Privacy (App Store) and Data safety (Google Play) answers come from it: node <skill>/scripts/audit-repo.mjs . --answers prints them. Change it in the same commit as the code or package that changes what the app collects.

react-native-google-mobile-ads.why: banner and interstitial ads for free users (admob-ads-and-consent)

expo-iap.why: the Premium unlock, verified on the device (in-app-purchases)

expo-notifications.why: task reminders and pushes (local-notifications, push-notifications); the push token is registered without an account (contracts/push.json requiresAccount false), so it is not linked to a person

expo-web-browser.why: opens the sign-in page and help links in the system browser

expo-auth-session.why: installed by the canonical stack; the reference app builds no sign-in yet (auth-and-secure-storage)

permissionAnswers.camera: not-collected: task photos stay on the device unless the person shares them
permissionAnswers.photos: not-collected: task photos stay on the device unless the person shares them
permissionAnswers.notifications: not-collected: the permission only lets the device show reminders
permissionAnswers.storage: not-collected: legacy storage permissions the prebuild template merges; files stay on the device
permissionAnswers.overlay: not-collected: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW from the prebuild template; development builds use it for the dev menu
